fields.reasoning: The change set intent says builder sessions' actor records are committed with the work they sign, and that no builder's record is left untracked after a build run. That fixes the scope to builder actors' records. The rhiza-build guide has a builder make one commit with a Leaf: trailer, so a separate record commit would break that shape. Including the record in the builder's one commit keeps the Actor: trailer and its committed record together. Nothing in the slice (no decisions, constraints or evidence) contradicts this.
fields.statement: Every builder actor record in the build worktree is committed in the builder's own leaf commit, so the Actor: trailer names an actor whose record is tracked after the run. Only builder sessions' actor records are in scope.
